test_adapter_positional_numpy_consistenc: test that JAX and PyTorch array adapters produce results consistent with NumPy adapters for axis info and truncated data
test_pytorch_named_axes_info: test that PyTorch named tensors return correct NamedPositionalAxisInfo alongside positional axis info
test_array_rendering_without_error: test that treescope.render_array renders NumPy, JAX, and PyTorch arrays with and without masks without errors
test_array_autovisualization: test that treescope.ArrayAutovisualizer automatically renders arrays to HTML containing arrayviz when used as a scoped autovisualizer
test_adapter_truncation_and_masking: test that ndarray adapter get_array_data_with_truncation handles unmasked, masked, semitruncated, and fully truncated arrays consistently across frameworks
